suggestions.topic: Hoodi testnet date finalization following ACDC decision
suggestions.rationale: Deferred from ACDT #104 to ACDC for formal lock-in; testnet date blocking mainnet planning for January 2027. No-spec-change position on EIP-8037 needs confirmation.

suggestions.topic: Bogota devnet-3 scope and readiness assessment
suggestions.rationale: Deferred from ACDT #104 pending frames spec progress (EIP-8288 forward-compat, leanSPHINCS params). Client teams split on go/no-go; needs resolution before devnet can launch.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8141 frames proof-frame vs signature-list design decision
suggestions.rationale: Core open question blocking bogota devnet-3 and frames forward-compatibility with EIP-8288/leanPCS. Lightclient leaning toward proof frame; needs consensus before spec can finalize.

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam devnet and mainnet preparation status
suggestions.rationale: Post-ACDC formal decision on EIP-8037 spec, check devnet health (devnet-8, devnet-12) and client release readiness. Mainnet targeting January 2027 per affected protocol signals.
Heze-devnet-3 torn down after quick slots removed; no active CL-focused devnet. Revisit timing and scope for next heze iteration given shorter-slots remain on feature branch.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8360 TCREATE pairing with EIP-4758 deactivate self-destruct
suggestions.rationale: jochem flagged that if deactivate self-destruct ships, TCREATE should be prioritized to avoid economic disruption. Status of both EIPs unclear; needs scoping decision for Hegota.

suggestions.topic: Process improvements: invariant documentation and audit workflows
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #103 and #104 discussed documenting stable vs expected-to-change invariants (Marius proposal), merging specs PRs #3948/#3982, and systematizing agent-swarm analysis. Update on progress.

suggestions.topic: Client release coordination and testing coverage
suggestions.rationale: Several clients missing from recent devnets (Erigon from bogota-devnet-2, Nimbus/Besu offline on Glamsterdam devnet-8). Check inter-client coordination ahead of Hoodi testnet.
